tagline: Offline Torah Notes & Hebrew Handwriting OCR Studio
taglineHebrew: סטודיו אופליין לזיהוי ועריכת כתב יד תורני ומחברות שיעורים
releaseTitle: v1.3.5 — Sequential Batch OCR Scanning, Automatic Sideways Notebook Orientation & Persistent Logging
description: Ohr HaKsav (אור הכתב) v1.3.5 fixes multi-page batch scanning so 'Scan All Pages' transcribes every attached page sequentially, adds automatic landscape/sideways notebook detection to prevent single-letter column scans, and introduces persistent diagnostic logging to %APPDATA%\OhrHaKsav\app.log.
features: Full Sequential Batch OCR Scanning: 'Scan All Pages' now processes all attached notebook pages consecutively without stopping after the first page, updating progress and editor text automatically.

Smart Sideways Notebook Auto-Orientation: Automatically detects when photos are taken sideways in landscape orientation and auto-rotates them 90° so Hebrew handwriting lines run horizontally, preventing single-letter vertical column recognition.

Persistent Diagnostic Application Logging: Automatically records startup, update checks, image imports, auto-orientations, batch progress, and exceptions to %APPDATA%\OhrHaKsav\app.log for easy troubleshooting.

Interactive User Guide & Training Tutorial (F1): Comprehensive in-app guide and tutorial explaining the 3-step workflow, how to train the AI handwriting memory bank from proofreader corrections, managing multi-writer profiles, keyboard shortcuts, and offline features.
Dedicated Help Toolbar Button (❓): One-click access to the user guide and training walkthrough directly from the top action toolbar.
Lightning-Fast Application Startup: Streamlined initialization so Ohr HaKsav opens instantly in ~1.1 seconds.
Embedded Windows PE File Version Resource: All executables embed official Windows File Version (1.3.5.0), Product Version, and Company metadata visible in File Explorer Properties > Details.
Version-Labeled Installer Executable: Setup wizard is packaged as OhrHaKsav_Setup_v1.3.5.exe for clear version identification.

Pre-Flight Internet Connection Verification: Non-blocking socket verification on port 53 avoids network timeouts and provides helpful, offline-friendly guidance when running on isolated school/Yeshiva servers.
Silent Startup Background Update Check: Automatically and quietly checks for updates in the background on launch (configurable in Settings, default ON).

In-App Top Notification Banner: Displays a sleek, non-intrusive notification banner across the top of the main window when a new release is detected, featuring instant [Install Update Now], [What's New], and [Dismiss] controls.
Enhanced Offline & Network Domain Mode: Full support for local file paths and Windows Server domain UNC shares (e.g. \\newltcserver\Installs\OhrHaKsav).
